text: Given a mocked contact matching "jane", When halopsa_users_search({query: "jane"}), Then the response lists only that contact, record_count matches the row count
tests: src/__tests__/domains/users.test.ts::halopsa_users_search::should list only contacts matching the query

text: Given no mocked contact matches "zzz-no-match", When halopsa_users_search({query: "zzz-no-match"}), Then the response is {record_count: 0, users: []} with no thrown error
tests: src/__tests__/domains/users.test.ts::halopsa_users_search::should return an empty list, not an error, when nothing matches

text: Given a mocked contact with id 101, When halopsa_users_get({contact_id: 101}), Then the response is that contact's full mocked record
tests: src/__tests__/domains/users.test.ts::halopsa_users_get::should return the full contact record by id

text: Given the mocked client rejects an unknown id, When halopsa_users_get({contact_id: 999999}), Then the handler surfaces a clear error, not an empty/default object
tests: src/__tests__/domains/users.test.ts::halopsa_users_get::should surface a clear error for an unknown contact id

text: Given the mocked duplicate-check search returns no rows, When halopsa_users_create({name, email: "new@x.com"}), Then client.users.create is called once and its result (with new id) is returned
tests: src/__tests__/domains/users.test.ts::halopsa_users_create::should create the contact when no existing contact has that email

text: Given the mocked duplicate-check search returns one row with email "jane@x.com", When halopsa_users_create({name, email: "jane@x.com"}), Then client.users.create is never called, and the response identifies the existing contact's id + email
tests: src/__tests__/domains/users.test.ts::halopsa_users_create::should refuse to create and report the existing contact on an exact email match

text: Given the mocked duplicate-check search returns one row with email "Jane@X.com", When halopsa_users_create({..., email: "jane@x.com"}) (different case), Then the duplicate is still detected (case-insensitive compare) and no create call is made

Given a mocked existing contact {id: 101, name: Jane, phonenumber: 111, email: jane@x.com}, When halopsa_users_update({contact_id: 101, phonenumber: "222"}) with no other fields, Then the payload passed to client.users.update contains only phonenumber: "222" (plus contact_id routing), with name/email keys absent (undefined)
tests: src/__tests__/domains/users.test.ts::halopsa_users_update::should send only the fields the caller provided

text: Given the same existing contact, When halopsa_users_update({contact_id: 101}) with no other fields at all, Then the call still succeeds as a no-op and no field keys beyond contact_id are sent in the payload
tests: src/__tests__/domains/users.test.ts::halopsa_users_update::should be a legal no-op when only contact_id is sent

text: Given an active mocked contact, When halopsa_users_update({contact_id: 101, inactive: true}), Then the payload sent includes inactive: true and the mocked return reflects it
tests: src/__tests__/domains/users.test.ts::halopsa_users_update::should deactivate a contact via inactive true

text: Given the same contact now mocked as inactive, When halopsa_users_update({contact_id: 101, inactive: false}) is called again, Then the payload sent includes inactive: false (reactivation round-trip)
tests: src/__tests__/domains/users.test.ts::halopsa_users_update::should reactivate a contact via inactive false

text: Given two mocked sites, When halopsa_sites_list({}) with no filter, Then the response lists both, each with at least id and name, via listResult
tests: src/__tests__/domains/sites.test.ts::halopsa_sites_list::should list all sites with id and name

text: Given a live/sandbox tenant with at least two clients that each have at least one site, When halopsa_sites_list({client_id: <clientA>}) is called against the real API, Then only client A's sites are returned, not client B's
steps: Obtain or set up a HaloPSA sandbox/dev tenant with at least two clients, each with at least one site
Call halopsa_sites_list with client_id set to client A's id
expect: Every returned site belongs to client A; no site belonging to client B appears in the response
notes: Needs a real/sandbox HaloPSA tenant with multi-client site data, not available in this design session; left for the dev leg or later manual verification.

text: Security (OWASP API1:2023 BOLA): Given two separate mocked credential contexts (tenant A, tenant B) bound via runWithCredentials, When tenant A calls any of the five new tools, Then the resolved SDK client instance and its mock data are strictly tenant A's, and tenant B's mocked contacts/sites are never reachable from tenant A's call
tests: src/__tests__/domains/users.test.ts::multi-tenant isolation::should never resolve another tenant's client or data (PRD-20396, OWASP API1 BOLA)
